acceptance: Each plan can extract independently; matching source traces and full consumer evidence are explicit acceptance, not assumed from common scaffolding. Feeds C02.complete: zero unexplained prepared/current TS observable differences; extraction never collapses differing policies.

arithmetic_rule.prohibition: Do not rewrite exact arithmetic merely for a baseline. Baselines observe current behavior; they do not re-derive it.
rules: Use arbitrary-precision raw/scratch arithmetic first, preserving accepted BigInt operands.
Decimal.js (or any third-party numeric library) is secondary value evidence, never a scale/error oracle.
Fixtures must include outputs erased by canonical wire text (raw vectors, not only rendered text).
Deterministic regeneration of new fixtures must preserve published packages/values/conformance/v1 unchanged.

comparison_method.differential_observers: Each plan builds its own current/prepared TS observers and differential shell against its own fixtures. Required observed dimensions: raw outputs (pre-render bytes/values), ordered traces (stage/step/callback order), side-effect counts, stdout/stderr bytes where applicable, and complete-consumer results.
comparison_method.independence: A02/V02/W02/P02 contribute their own prepared evidence later; no plan may claim prepared/current agreement from common scaffolding alone or from another plan's differential run.
comparison_method.matching_traces: Prepared TS must reproduce current TS observable traces exactly: stage order, first-failure/first-error order, enumeration order, callback invocation order, and evaluation timing boundaries. Any difference is either fixed in the prepared extraction or recorded as an explicit owned divergence with consumer impact; unexplained differences fail C02.complete.
comparison_method.no_self_oracle: Two wrappers calling the same helper is never the sole oracle. Producer-direction comparisons run against frozen originals; oracles are pinned fixture bytes/traces, not the sibling implementation under test.
comparison_method.selection: TS mode is an explicit supported configuration. Route declared unsupported legacy input profiles to TS before evaluation, preserving existing reads and errors; keep a single selection throughout a request/job; never retry failed semantic work across modes.
comparison_method.source_of_truth: Current TS (existing package sources at the execution checkout) is the behavior oracle. Prepared TS (extracted orchestration route / prepared modules) must match it observably before any native comparison begins.

extraction_review_rules: Extract around current helpers without reordering stages, activation, dispatch, review, publication, or error precedence; initially delegate existing helpers through their public boundaries.
No eager reads past the current refusal point: no eager previous-plan reads, no speculative builds, no live apply, no pre-evaluation of lazy inputs.
No duplicate host execution on effectful inputs: each external stage (Bun build, catalog resume, activation probe, publication) occurs once at its current position in both current and prepared runs.
Getters, callbacks, and evidence hooks are never shadow-run twice and never eagerly snapshotted or shadow-executed; callback timing, order, and exception propagation are preserved.

Single writer per extraction file/lane per ownership.json; bundle/helper/export changes that cross a prepared boundary go through the directed handoff (e.g. C04.preparation-join), never as silent drive-by edits.
Extraction deltas are behaviour-preserving refactors with before/after differential evidence; any intentional semantic change is a separate owned task, not part of the baseline.

fixture_attribution.determinism: Every fixture records seeds, source/environment versions, input bytes, and output bytes/traces; regeneration is deterministic and reproducible by a second worker from the record alone.
fixture_attribution.provenance: Each vector names its producing owner (plan lane + source suite/file), the baseline run that captured it, and the policy profile it exercises (see preserved_policies).
fixture_attribution.retention: Raw outputs are retained even when canonical renderings erase them; legacy traces (hand-built schemas, unknown encode/decode inputs, full legacy scope) are retained as first-class fixtures, not summarized away.
fixture_attribution.schema_coordination: Raw-output/environment/resource record shapes follow C05.1 workloads.json/observations.mjs once published; until then each plan records its schema version inline and must reconcile at C05.ready.

per_plan_bindings.artifact_preparation: P02.1 freezes the prepared-job/stage contract (bare/preview/confirmed/preview+yes/compiler-mismatch/missing-worker/competing-failure expectations); P02.2 extracts host wrappers; P02.3 builds the full-job differential with subprocess-ready timing boundaries. Whole-job prepared-TS cost is the primary comparator.
per_plan_bindings.exact_values: A02.1 captures deterministic raw/observable numeric vectors; A02.2 builds the current/prepared TS observers and differential shell plus workloads. Decimal.js stays secondary evidence.
per_plan_bindings.input_validation: V02.1 prepares immutable owner plans (descriptor/default/bounds mutation and forged tags must not promote legacy schemas); V02.2 prepares the values AST codec + whole-call comparator over the values matrix and legacy traces; V02.3 prepares the interfaces HTTP framing/binding plan with ordered first-error rules and deferral distinctions.
per_plan_bindings.work_transitions: W02.2 extracts ordered row/identity/set mechanisms against frozen originals (both producer directions); W02.3 extracts retry/recurrence/lifecycle decisions with explicit supplied randomness and host-owned hashing/recurrence bytes.

planning_status: proposed; method contract only; no implementation authorized by this record

preserved_policies.auth_policy: Authorization stays host-owned: by-aware gates, live membership evaluation, revocation/commit fencing, and grant routing are never moved into prepared decision modules. Prepared work/state mechanisms receive authority outcomes as inputs; they do not re-decide them.
preserved_policies.clone_policy: JSON-safe transfer versus clone-only retention stay distinct profiles. Frozen retained payloads and unknown result values need lossless transfer or explicit host retention; extraction must not silently serialize what the host retains by reference.
preserved_policies.error_policy: Each plan keeps its own error shape, order, and precedence: ordered reason lists, first-failure attribution, host JSON syntax diagnostics vs semantic check failures, refusal-before-publication staging. Native/host error mapping is a later C03 concern; prepared TS reproduces current TS errors exactly.
preserved_policies.evaluation_policy: Lazy/eager evaluation boundaries, callback timing, single randomness consumption after validation/exhaustion checks, fractional-timestamp acceptance, and boundary inclusivity are preserved per plan. Extraction never makes lazy paths eager or collapses per-plan timing profiles into one.
preserved_policies.presence_policy: Explicit own null/undefined, missing-vs-present, default application/omission, and null-companion spellings differ per package (values vs interfaces vs generated forms). Prepared extractions preserve each owner's presence semantics exactly; no unified presence normalization during baselining.
